Join us Friday, October 23, or Saturday, October 24, for a rare late night of paranormal investigation with the Boo Fighters!

Date and time

  • Oct 23, 2026 07:00 PM - 11:00 PM

Location

Augusta Colonial Theater, 139 Water Street, Augusta, ME 04330

About this event

Join DJ, Ariel and other members of the Boo Fighters paranormal team for a fun night of "ghost hunting" (AKA paranormal investigation) at the historic Augusta Colonial Theater.

Tickets are extremely limited so get them now! Each evening the Colonial will allow entry to 25 ticket holders who will be trained in the tools of paranormal investigation, then sent off in smaller groups of up to five people, led by trained members of the Boo Fighters team, to search for paranormal phenomena.

The Augusta Colonial Theater was built in 1913 and has a storied history, including tales of sightings. Past investigations have provided findings. Old timers can tell you stories. While we can't guarantee any activity during your investigation, we've met many visitors who've experienced a variety of phenomena and have even experienced some strange happenings ourselves!

This rare night time investigation is perfect for this Halloween season. Be among the first to see recent renovation work, but there are plenty of spaces yet unrestored. Investigations will take place both Friday, October 23rd and Saturday, October 24th from 7-11 pm. There will be concessions for sale should you need some sustinence during your investigation and rumor has it that the Boo Fighters will be brining some merch available for purchase and order.

Due to the nature of this event and ongoing construction at the theater, there are a few limitations you should be aware of. This is intended to be an adult-only event. There will be no admission to those under 13, and minors who are not yet 18 will need to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. As we are under construction, there will be liability waivers that need to be completed and all guests will receive a brief safety training. Additionally, access to some areas of the theater will be limited for those with mobility constraints, though the main floor is accessible. Please reach out beforehand with any questions or special requests.. You can contact us by e-mail at info@augustacolonialtheater.com or by phone at 207-209-3525.
